title: Amendment No. 1, Agreement for Architectural Services – HKIT Architects – Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Agreement for Architectural Services by and between the District and HKIT Architects, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide additional  architectural and engineering services which includes design development, prepare construction documents, and contract administration for the site visits, seismic retrofit & interior improvements of the classroom and replacement of the existing kitchen/dinning building, as described in the proposal dated November 10, 2021, attached to this Amendment as Exhibit A, for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project, in an additional amount of $5,725,642.00, which includes a contingency of $365,507.00, and $50,000.00, for reimbursable expenses, increasing Agreement not-to-exceed amount from $29,000.00 to $5,754,642.00, and extending the term of the Agreement from May 13, 2021 through May 21, 2024 to May 21, 2026, (an additional 730 calendar days), and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Amendment for same with said Contractor.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $5.73M and two years for HKIT Architects' design of the Roosevelt Middle School modernization
summary: This amendment adds more architectural and engineering work for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project, including design development, construction documents, seismic retrofit and interior classroom improvements, and replacing the kitchen/dining building. It raises the contract limit from $29,000 to $5,754,642, which includes a $365,507 contingency and $50,000 for reimbursable expenses. It also extends the contract end date from May 21, 2024 to May 21, 2026. The work is paid from Measure J bond funds.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Rook Electric – Surveillance Upgrades McClymonds High School Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor, by and between the District and Rook Electric, Oakland, CA, for, due to unforeseen conditions, installation of new AIPhone power supply, and connection of the power supply to the existing security system, for the Surveillance Upgrades McClymonds High School Project, in the additional amount of $215.80, pursuant to proposal dated November 12, 2021, increasing the not to exceed amount of Agreement from $47,380.00 to $47,595.80. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $215.80 to Rook Electric's McClymonds High surveillance upgrade for an unforeseen power supply
summary: This change order pays Rook Electric to install a new power supply for the AIPhone intercom and connect it to the existing security system at McClymonds High School. The work was needed because of unforeseen conditions. It raises the contract limit from $47,380 to $47,595.80, paid from Measure J bond funds.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 6, Independent Consultant Agreement – Integral Group, Inc. – Fremont High School New Construction Project – Division of Facilities Planning & Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 6, Independent Consultant Agreement between the District and Integral Group, Inc., Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide additional commissioning services, due to new issues having surfaced and previous issues having not been resolved, for the Fremont High School New Construction Project, in the additional amount of $15,400.00, increasing the Agreement not to exceed amount from $339,806.25 to 355,206.25. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remaining in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $15,400 for Integral Group's building-systems testing at the new Fremont High School
summary: This amendment pays Integral Group, Inc. for more commissioning services (testing that building systems work as designed) on the Fremont High School New Construction Project. The extra work is needed because new issues surfaced and earlier ones were not resolved. It raises the contract limit from $339,806.25 to $355,206.25, paid from Measure J bond funds.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Fifth Amendment, Office Lease - Sparknight, LLC - Central Administrative Offices - 1000 Broadway, Oakland, CA
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Fifth Amendment, Lease Agreement by and between the Oakland Unified School District (“District) as lessee, and Sparknight, LLC, a Florida limited liability company, as lessor (“Lessor”), for space within the building located at 1000 Broadway, Oakland, CA 94607, commonly known as the Transpacific Centre, in which the  District and Lessor propose to: (1) further extend the termination date of the Original Lease, as amended, by one year to August 31, 2023; (2) reduce the premises rented by the District from Lessor by calling for the District to surrender Suite 300 back to the Lessor; (3) establish the amount of monthly base rent to be owed by the District to the Lessor; (4) describe the District’s and Lessor’s rights and obligations with regard to certain move‐out and close‐out procedures to be performed by District with regard to Suite 300; (5) grant the District the option to extend the termination date of the Lease by one additional period of six months; and (6) modify the rights of the District to parking at the Property, for $2,501,550.00 total annual rent under the Fifth Amendment, for the term of September 1, 2022 through August 31, 2023.
headline: Extends the district's 1000 Broadway office lease one year at $2.5M annual rent; gives up Suite 300
summary: This fifth amendment extends the lease for the district's central administrative offices at 1000 Broadway (the Transpacific Centre) by one year, to August 31, 2023. The district gives back Suite 300 and sets a new monthly base rent, totaling $2,501,550 a year. The district also gets an option to extend six more months, and parking rights change.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
